title: A phone scan becomes a PDF report
about: A room scanned with a phone, measured, and printed as a report.

steps.say: This plan came from a phone: a RoomPlan scan sent to the server.
Every doorway in the phone scan, measured against the clear width a wheelchair needs.
Then the turning space in each room.

else.say: Then a census of the rooms.

steps.say: The investigation holds every run and finding.

steps.label: Download report
steps.say: One click prints it as the PDF a landlord or contractor keeps.
